pairs.subject: public-claim-provenance
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/layout.tsx:1 These @gt/ui state/origin primitives render only inside the authenticated (studio) operator shell. The public landing (app/page.tsx renders only Cosmos; app/_landing imports none of Tally/SourceTag/StackBar/PipRow/StatusPill/Provenance/ChannelBadge), and a case-insensitive grep of the context's eleven component directories for roadmap|marketing|landing|public|seed found zero hits, so no outward claim surface with an unverifying reader exists here.

techniques.evidence: packages/ui/src/components/tally/Tally.tsx:15 Tally draws a ratio but authors neither half; both come from the caller, on operator screens, not a public progress fraction.

packages/ui/src/components/stackbar/StackBar.tsx:20 Empty pile is guarded at its one computation and spoken/drawn values read the same props, but there is no hand-authored target against a live count. Tally has no value<=of check, which would matter only on a public surface.

packages/ui/src/components/status/status.ts:151 Closed status vocabulary, defined once, degrading toward attention. This is operator job/run state, not a public request-time counter with a liveness badge.

packages/ui/src/components/source/SourceTag.tsx:14 SourceTag is an inline provenance label the reader can see (real/model/illustrative/fixture/derived), but it qualifies operator-facing figures, not hand-typed public claims.

packages/ui/src/components/consequence/ConsequencePanel.tsx:87 The confirm panel renders the adapter's own sentences about what the commit will do, word for word. It is an operator HITL dialog, not a public success panel promising a follow-up.

pairs.registryProposal: Scope note: the subject restricts itself to public surfaces, yet operator tools with a fixture/real produce-side switch show the same seeded-vs-derived problem (fixture values in the same typography as real ones). A pointer stating whether that case belongs to measurement-honesty or to this subject's degraded-never-claims-live would help seats sort internal SourceTag-style provenance chips.
